column1: # Settings registry: the single source (awto/include/settings.h). Generated from it by awto-ddc scripts/settings_gen.py:
# set_table, OSD menu pages (with settings/pages.tsv), DDC/CI VCP map, NVRAM record + schema, host table, docs/settings.md.
# - id: stable, never reused (NVRAM key, VCP paged id, docs anchor). 1..255 (the NVRAM record keys are one byte).
# - retired ids (never reuse): 64 menu_select, 93 vendor_menu (Realtek SDK menu built out, awto-ddc#120); 65 logo,
#   66 logo_ms (boot logo removed, the console shows the power-on log, awto-ddc#144); 69 panel_t3, 70 panel_t3_own
#   (backlight no longer waits for video: 118 bl_on_delay, Dan 2026-11-13, awto-ddc#162).
# - type: bool | enum | int | action. unit: none percent ms s step hz dhz (0.1 Hz).
# - flags: nv (saved), live (applied on every change, else on confirm), risky (can blank or cut access: auto-revert
#   unless confirmed), reboot (takes effect after a restart), ro (status, read from the firmware), inert (stored only:
#   the firmware has no reader yet: Realtek SDK menu items not built, and our rows whose owner is still to wire it),
#   factory (factory page only), sdk (value lives in a Realtek SDK store field: stored in the SDK store, one RAM copy;
#   nv rows without sdk go into the integrator's own items of the same store, awto-ddc#151).
# - nv_slot: auto = position in the NVRAM record (id-tagged, so slots may move). vcp: MCCS code, or a manufacturer
#   code 0xE6..0xFF (0xE0..0xE5 are the paged pair 0xE0 id / 0xE1 value, schema, command, menu), or '-';
#   every row is reachable through the paged pair. The DDC/CI capabilities string is generated from this column.
#   0xE9 = host time (table write, awto-ddc#157, firmware awto_ddcci.inc): never a row code.
# - apply: set_ap_<apply>(id, value) pushes it to the firmware; '-' = the owner reads the value when it needs it.
# - options: enum labels, '|' separated; label=N gives the VCP value of that option (default: the option index).
# - provenance: [sdk-ui] = item, range and default of the Realtek SDK (demo) menu, walked in the sim (#65, #67).
# id
